scene: CHARACTER-INTRODUCTION splash, a dramatic manhwa cover two-shot. MEDIUM CLOSE. BOTH FACES LARGE, waist-up, filling the frame, low three-quarter from the millstone. SAME packed-earth Hwarang yard as the wall-paint still: pale plaster hall, curved giwa, a worn millstone in the yard, paper-white day sky. FOREGROUND, huge and soft: millstone rim and a thick hemp rope almost touching the lens. MIDGROUND, razor-sharp: young Chunchu (LEFT face — magenta-crimson silk po, charcoal sash, crescent-moon headband, two thin jougwan pins, clean-shaven) just sat down on the millstone, rope slung on his shoulder, mouth open, hit in the chest by a small brown pear CORE frozen mid-air (never a bone). Behind him on the low giwa yard wall, Yushin (SECOND face — Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash, crescent-moon headband, BEARDLESS) sits sideways eating a pear, already turning away, one hand flicking the core; he is only passing through, NOT a marshal, NO armour, NO sword. ONE device: the pear core between their two large faces. Magenta #D8258C on Chunchu's silk, blue #2A5FB8 on Yushin's sleeve. Faces from the sheet. No text.

at: The king throws a lacquer cup at him.

scene: CHARACTER-INTRODUCTION splash, a dramatic manhwa cover two-shot. MEDIUM CLOSE. BOTH FACES LARGE, chest-up, filling the frame — the look of Sadaham's own intro card. SAME night Silla timber hall as that intro: crushed-black room, one oil lamp set down on the boards, paper lattice, timber pillars receding. Dutch low three-quarter. FOREGROUND, soft: the floor lamp flame, the king's red sleeve falling into the light. MIDGROUND: King Jinhung (LEFT face from the sheet — keep that bearded house face) mid-sit on his own timber step, thrown backward by his own throw, mouth open, comedy not dignity; deep red court silk, wide sleeves; on his head the OPEN Silla gold crown (narrow band, three flat 出 tree uprights front and over the ears, two shorter antler uprights at the BACK only, jade gogok, temple pendants) — NEVER a European spiked crown, NEVER a closed basket, NEVER horns at the sides, NEVER a black gat. The unnamed hwarang (SECOND face = Sadaham — ice-blue #6fa8ff silk, black crescent-moon headband, long hair, no jougwan, no helm) still on one knee, not looking up, the cup having just kissed the band. ONE device: a red-lacquer cup frozen mid-air on the way BACK toward the king, between their two large faces. #2f6fd4 as lamp bounce on the king; #6fa8ff as specular on the boy's band. Painted webtoon splash, NEVER photoreal. Faces from the sheet. No text.

scene: CHARACTER-INTRODUCTION splash, a dramatic manhwa cover two-shot. MEDIUM CLOSE. BOTH FACES LARGE, waist-up. SAME wet square as the rope-line still after rain: packed wet stone, puddles, a long line of captives in undyed white kneeling, smoking curved giwa roofs, a timber gate with a two-tier munru dissolving behind. FOREGROUND, huge and soft: a thick hemp rope and Sadaham's knife cutting the knot, almost touching the lens. MIDGROUND, razor-sharp: Sadaham (LEFT face — steel lamellar, ice-blue #6fa8ff cloth at the collar and sleeves, black crescent-moon headband, helm off, long hair, belt knife in his fist) kneeling, cutting the captive rope, not looking up, the face of a boy who felt like it. The unnamed general (SECOND face, helm-shadow) STANDING over him watching, not sitting, not in the mud: steel lamellar, purple #8B5CF6 peek at collar and plume-cord ONLY (NO purple cape), and his TALL GAYA CONE HELM ON HIS HEAD — rounded dark-iron bowl, wide flared iron brim-and-neck flange, crowned by a tall cone of RED horsehair, red chin cords. NEVER a Japanese kabuto, NEVER a jingasa hat, NEVER a pointed purple spike, NEVER a Silla pointed helm. They meet here, over the knot. Low sun through smoke. Faces from the sheet. No army catalog. No text.
